import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x = int(data[0])
    y = int(data[1])
    n = int(data[2])

    answerA = 0
    answerB = 1
    best = float('inf')

    den = 1
    while den <= n:
        rem = (den * x) % y
        d = rem if rem < y - rem else y - rem
        cur = d / den

        if best > cur:
            best = cur
            answerB = den
            q = (den * x) // y
            answerA = q if rem <= y - rem else q + 1

        den += 1

    sys.stdout.write(f"{answerA}/{answerB}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
